# Eclipse Launcher Beta 3 — the overhaul checkpoint

This beta brings together the launcher redesign and the work completed since Beta 2, published on July 19, 2026. Eclipse remains the name for this checkpoint.

## A new launcher workspace

- Redesigned Home, Library, Addons, instance pages, Settings and Customization around shared materials, spacing and controls.
- Image-led worlds and server cards, new Minecraft scene artwork, and a player preview that supports mouse, touch and keyboard rotation.
- Warm light surfaces, frosted and liquid glass materials, working appearance preferences and reduced-motion support.
- Playtime charts with hover/focus details, server/world activity, and a dedicated Digital wellbeing page with optional daily limits and reminders.

## More useful installations and addons

- Managed installation folders, explicit import flows, clearer loader/client identity and fuller instance pages.
- Modrinth and CurseForge browsing, filters, continuous browsing, installation feedback and compatible mod update handling. CurseForge requires a configured API key.
- An OptiFine installer bridge that inspects your selected installer, prepares its matching Minecraft base and imports a separate installation. Imported OptiFine profiles retain their original icon and shader settings.
- Parallel download controls: one transfer when off, a remembered file count when on, and an independent bandwidth limit.

## A server workspace built for running a server

- A four-step Create server dialog: Customize, Software, Sharing and Review, including banner/icon editing and a Minecraft-style greeting preview.
- A console with readable severity and Minecraft colors, search, wrap/follow, log export and a command bar. Memory shows measured JVM heap against the server's assigned memory.
- Folder navigation and a local Monaco editor with save feedback and protection against losing unsaved changes.
- Players, plugins and worlds tools; grouped server options; and provider connection setup in Settings. Plugin browsing supports Modrinth and CurseForge.
- Player profiles include inventory, equipment, ender chest, statistics and draggable Minecraft-style advancement trees. Supported server runtimes can use the live companion for player reads and changes while running; unavailable live controls remain explicit.
- Overworld, Nether and End cards with dimension uploads, world backups and file access. Runtime/software changes have recovery paths, and world downgrades require a fresh world or a compatible backup.
- Reinstall now offers **Back up and reinstall** or **Reinstall without backup**, with an explicit full-reset warning. Runtime repair remains separate.
- Join chooses a matching installed client, or offers compatible choices, then launches Minecraft with the server address. Known loader builds and modpack identities are checked rather than guessed from names.

## Skins, capes and Minecraft details

- Separate Skin, Capes and Cosmetics sections, regular cape selection beside its heading, and animated cape previews with account ownership checks.
- Shared skin/cosmetics delivery, locally cached previews and internal cosmetic resources instead of selectable generated resource packs.
- Improved inventory item renders, player-head fallbacks, held-item transforms and folded elytra geometry.
- Advancement trees with connected branches, chapter tabs, drag panning, search and hover/focus details in both server and saved-world profiles.

## Less repeated work and better recovery

- Shared startup requests, bounded caches, lazy loading of the file editor and buffered Minecraft archive reads reduce repeated loading and world refresh work.
- Clearer launch/import/download errors and stronger handling of stale responses, interrupted writes and conflicting mod updates.
- A new native installer with animated scenes and a feature tour; a separate updater and redesigned uninstaller.
- The update notice stays compact. **What's new** shows the offered release's notes; **Update & restart** hands off to the updater and reopens the launcher.
- Installer cancellation now completes cleanup and closes instead of remaining stuck in a cancelling state.

## Before testing

- **Moving from July's Beta 2:** download the new **Eclipse-Setup.exe**. That release uses the previous installer/update format and cannot be assumed to migrate through the new updater. Keep a backup of existing launcher and game data, and do not run the old uninstaller's data-removal option during migration.
- This is a Windows x64 beta. Actual compatibility varies by Minecraft version, loader, client and server software; it is not a claim that every combination has been tested.
- Saved single-player world profiles are read only. Live server edits require the supported companion and connection checks. Microsoft animated cape linking is not available yet.
- Public server discovery and hosted-server purchasing remain Coming soon. Future social features and the rename are outside this checkpoint.
- Please include the launcher version, Minecraft/loader version and steps to reproduce when reporting a problem. Remove tokens, account credentials and private addresses from shared logs.
